title: Adverbs of Frequency in Order
description: Master where to place adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, never) in English sentences.

thumbnail.alt: A minimalist calendar with frequency checkboxes and a pocket watch on a wooden table
thumbnail.prompt: A minimalist calendar with frequency checkboxes and a pocket watch on a wooden table. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no real or famous people, no watermark. Full-bleed flat background color from edge to edge: no frame, no border, no round or oval vignette, no wreath, no mandala or ornament in the middle of the image. aspect ratio 16:10

items.sentence: He is always late for class.
items.translation: Ele está sempre atrasado para a aula.
items.hint: Put the adverb AFTER the verb 'to be'.

items.sentence: We usually eat dinner at home.
items.hint: Put the adverb BEFORE main verbs.

items.sentence: They often visit their grandparents on Sundays.
items.translation: Eles frequentemente visitam os avós aos domingos.

items.sentence: I sometimes listen to music while studying.
items.translation: Às vezes eu escuto música enquanto estudo.
Você quase nunca fica com raiva.

items.sentence: My teacher is always very patient with us.
items.translation: Meu professor é sempre muito paciente conosco.
